title: Mughal Society The Middle Strata
definition: The middle strata in Mughal society comprised a diverse, non-homogenous group of professionals, merchants, lower-level officials, and artisans who bridged the gap between the ruling elite (Mansabdars) and the agrarian peasantry.
importanceInUpsc: UPSC frequently tests the socio-economic structure of the Mughal period to assess the candidate's understanding of urban growth, commercialization, and the rise of the 'middle class' in pre-colonial India.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Mughal Society The Middle Strata.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
